fieldValues.title: Escalation: may an RFC reopen RFC-039's retired field-id bridge? (srs#931)
fieldValues.decision_question: May the group's queue carry srs#931, which needs a new RFC amending RFC-039's retirement of the field-id keyword, and who authors it?
fieldValues.context: Problem: Clients that work from a type schema or from find facets cannot name a field by its id; RFC-039 retired the bridge keyword and no binding resolves it. srs-web#547 (durable Lenses addresses) and board columns need a stable field identity. Why it matters: a name is not a stable identity, since two Types can share a Field.name and facets merge them; the fix amends accepted normative meaning (Door 2), which the builder mandate excludes, and touches one-way-per-goal. Options and consequences: (A) Expose fieldId beside name in type_schema properties and find facets: one call for clients, but reopens a retired keyword. (B) Add a separate resolution read (typeId, typeVersion, name) to fieldId: projection stays clean, clients pay one more call. (C) Do nothing: srs-web keeps addressing by name and collides on shared names. Recommendation: authorise an RFC that weighs A against B (Charter Check first); no implementation issue until accepted. Action needed: decide whether the RFC is authorised and by whom. Urgency: low; srs-web#547 can ship by name meanwhile. Answers: SP-05. Detail: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/issues/931
fieldValues.friction: The issue is labelled ready but its own Acceptance says no implementation is filed until an RFC is accepted. A builder cannot execute it: it is new normative meaning (Door 2), outside the group's mandate.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: A. RFC exposing fieldId in type_schema and find facets. B. RFC for a separate resolution read. C. Do nothing.
fieldValues.key_requirements: Charter Check and decision mode named; cell stated; amends RFC-039 Rev 6 explicitly; CLI payload and WASM binding alike; no client-side semantics.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Authorise an RFC for srs#931 weighing A and B, drafted through the rfc workflow; the builder takes no implementation until it is accepted.
fieldValues.rationale: New normative meaning needs an RFC (Door 2, rfc-decision-e99a9437); a name is not a stable identity.
fieldValues.revisit_when: The RFC is accepted or srs-web#547 needs the id before then.
fieldValues.next_steps: Owner authorises the RFC; srs#931 loses ready until an implementation issue exists.
